title: MiniPhi Context Graph Operations
description: The context graph language: operations a model emits to reshape its own layered context when the loaded context is not precise enough for the current task or subtask. Kept inline (no $ref) because MiniPhi validates responses with its own schema walker.

context_sufficient.description: False when the loaded context cannot answer the current step; MiniPhi then reforms the graph and re-prompts once.

context_gap.description: What is missing or imprecise, in concrete terms (node ids, symbols, file paths). Used to reform the graph.

context_ops.description: Ordered operations applied to the context graph after this turn (max 12).

op.description: expand loads a stub/digest back in full; pin keeps a node in every prompt; boost raises its selection score; collapse replaces it with your digest; drop discards it; note records a durable fact; link relates two nodes; open_subtask/close_subtask scope a sub-conversation; focus switches to an existing subtask.

node.description: Target node id as shown in [brackets] (required by pin/unpin/boost/expand/collapse/drop/focus).

text.description: Body for note, digest text for collapse, goal for open_subtask, outcome for close_subtask.

layer.description: Layer for note (mission/contract are runtime-owned and cannot be written by the model).

reason.description: Why this reshaping is needed (recorded in telemetry).
